Configure the source pipeline

Source: R/pipeline_options.R
pipeline_options.Rd

Use option constructors to configure related settings in run_one_source(). Each constructor returns an ordinary named list containing only the arguments supplied in the call.

Option groups

ArgumentConstructorSettings
cohort_selectioncohort_selection_optionsPopulation and table selection
windowswindow_optionsObservation-window construction
loadingloading_optionsImport and database loading
enrichmentenrichment_optionsClassification and scoring
conceptsconcept_optionsConcept definitions and layers
harmonizationharmonization_optionsOutput tables
executionexecution_optionsRebuilds and error handling

Defaults and validation

An omitted setting uses the receiving function's default. For example, loading_options() returns an empty list, whereas loading_options(ignore_errors = FALSE) requests strict CSV parsing. An explicitly supplied NULL is retained in the list. Constructor usage shows reference defaults; calling a constructor without that argument does not insert its reference value. Stage-specific defaults can differ, such as column validation for raw caching (TRUE) and cohort import (FALSE).

Constructors check option names and logical flags. Stage functions perform additional validation when the options are used. Direct stage functions use only settings applicable to that stage; other valid fields are ignored. A setting supplied both directly and in a group is an error, even when the values agree.

Selecting work

stages selects pipeline operations. concepts$layers selects layers within concept extraction. Providing an option group does not select its stage, and selecting concept layers does not change the harmonization output settings. For argument names accepted by earlier interfaces, see pipeline_compatibility.

See also

run_one_source(), run_concepts()

Examples

loading_options()
#> named list()
loading_options(ignore_errors = FALSE)
#> $ignore_errors
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
concept_options(layers = "flat")
#> $layers
#> [1] "flat"
#> 

# Ordinary named lists can also be used as option groups.
list(layers = "flat", dry_run = TRUE)
#> $layers
#> [1] "flat"
#> 
#> $dry_run
#> [1] TRUE
#>
